name: SwitchField
summary: Toggle a setting with a boolean switch and supporting validation text.

useWhen: Toggling a standalone setting that takes effect as soon as it is toggled.
Toggling a setting inside a staged form, which takes effect when the form is saved.
avoidWhen: For actions that require confirmation or choices with more than two states.

obligations: Root supports controlled and uncontrolled selection plus native name/value form serialization with field description and error linkage.

behavior: Root owns the state: checked or defaultChecked sets it.
onChange receives the new boolean, not a DOM event.
An on switch submits its name and value; an off switch submits nothing.
SwitchField saves nothing itself: the application saves in onChange, or reads the named value when its form submits.
A disabled switch ignores toggles and submits nothing.
A read-only switch ignores toggles and still submits while on.
Button is a label that wraps the switch input, not an action button, and its ref is the label element.
Root's ref is its wrapping div.
Description is linked to the input.
Error appears only while the field is invalid, and is linked to the input.
Interactive control sizes use the shared sm, md, and lg targets; md is the default.
accessibility: Root supports controlled and uncontrolled selection plus native name/value form serialization with field description and error linkage.
